title: Coproduct preservation of actual adic compact supports on the constructible localizing hull
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0$, its algebraic closure $k$, and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$. Write $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For each finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, on its small pro-etale site put $B_T=\Omega_T^{\mathrm{lf}}$, the sheaf of continuous $\Omega$-valued functions whose values locally span a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-space. Put $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$, with the internal-module convention of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], and let $\mathcal C_T\subset D(\mathcal A_T)$ be the full subcategory with bounded constructible cohomology: each cohomology sheaf is locally finite free on every member of a finite locally closed stratification, locally on $T$. Write $\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal C_T)$ for its full replete triangulated closure under small coproducts, computed in $D(\mathcal A_T)$ [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory, def-weil-size-convention]. For a separated finite-type $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ and a compactification $X\xrightarrow jZ\xrightarrow pY$ with $j$ open and $p$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], take $F=Rp_*D(j_!)$ on ordinary module derived categories, with the coefficient sheaves $B_T$ above and the actual sheaf functors used by the native construction. Then $F$ restricts to an exact functor $\mathcal L_X\to\mathcal L_Y$ preserving every small coproduct. Neither $X,Y$ nor $Z$ is required to be separated over $k$. This assertion is only on the indicated localizing hulls; it makes no assertion about coproducts on the entire ambient derived categories.

proof.text: Bundle the given finite field and its algebraic closure as FiniteFieldDatum using FiniteField.card. Apply [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction] and [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-realization]. The preserves field gives the actual compactification composite F(C_X) subset C_Y. Apply the same construction to a quasi-compact open immersion j with Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j. The proper factor is the identity; its right derived functor is naturally isomorphic to the identity through rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory, adicLowerStarId and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. Transport the preserves assertion across this isomorphism: D(j_!) maps C_X into C_Z.

Give the compactification middle scheme Z its structure map p followed by a_Y; the factorization equation makes j a k-map. Properness of p and finite type of Y imply finite type and quasi-compactness of Z. Since f is quasi-compact, Compactification.quasiCompact_openImmersion makes j quasi-compact. Exact native j_! preserves heart coproducts as a left adjoint, hence D(j_!) preserves derived coproducts. Minimality, via ObjectProperty.localizingClosure_le_inverseImage, extends the bounded constructible assertion of step 1 to J(L_X) subset L_Z. Lift J to those full subcategories. The target inclusion reflects colimits and its composite is the coproduct-preserving source inclusion followed by J, so the lift preserves coproducts.

Y is Noetherian by finite type over a field [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. The algebra k_0 to k identifies their characteristics. Apply [lem-sf-native-adic-proper-coproducts] to p and a_Y. Compose its functor from L_Z with the lifted open-extension functor of step 2. Its composite is definitionally the source-hull inclusion followed by the actual F, so F preserves coproducts on L_X.

The ambient F is triangulated: open extension is the derived functor of an exact functor, and the ordinary total right derived functor is triangulated [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated, lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. Apply ObjectProperty.localizingClosure_obj_of_le to F: step 3 supplies coproduct continuity on L_X, and step 1 supplies preservation of its generators. The localizing intersection of L_X with the inverse image of L_Y contains C_X, hence contains L_X. This gives the required h. ObjectProperty.isTriangulated_liftFullSubcategory gives exactness. The composite of the restriction with the target inclusion is the source inclusion followed by F, which preserves coproducts by step 3; reflection by the fully faithful target inclusion gives coproduct preservation of the restriction, for every Type (u+1), including the empty family.
